verdict.line: You lose if you eat her delayed Q recast during a wall-assisted E engage; you win if you save Feint for that exact window and out-sustain her with Q pokes.

brief.thesis: Camille's entire burst case runs through one mechanic: Precision Protocol (Q) can be held and recast for drastically more damage, and that recast is a single-target hit Shen can simply block. OP.GG's own read on this matchup is literally to save Feint (W) for that recast — do that consistently and her all-in stops being an all-in. Everything else (Hookshot engages, the ultimate anchor) only matters if that one trade goes through.

theirWindow.when: She's near a wall with E up
theirWindow.what: Hookshot (16/14/12/10/8s CD, range 800) only works within range of a wall. Near one, she can leap in, knock you up on landing, and immediately re-press Q for the delayed, heavily upgraded hit. If your W is down when this starts, back off instead of trading.

yourWindow.what: Hold W and watch her first Q cast. The moment she re-presses it for the big delayed hit, pop Feint (9/8/7/6/5s CD) to absorb it outright, then punish with Vorpal Blade while her Q is on full cooldown.

playing.title: Save W for the recast, not the first hit
playing.detail: Precision Protocol's first cast is minor; the delayed recast is the real damage. Bait the first hit, then Feint the second.

playing.title: Poke with Q at max range
playing.detail: Vorpal Blade (475 range, 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s CD) life-taps you on hit — use it to chip and sustain before she closes distance.

playing.title: Track wall proximity
playing.detail: Hookshot needs a wall within 800 range to function. Away from walls, her engage options collapse — trade freely there.

playing.title: Counter-dash her landing
playing.detail: If she commits Hookshot to engage, answer with Shadow Dash (575 range, 16-8s CD) to taunt her right as she lands and turn the fight back on her.

playing.title: Don't overextend once she's 6
playing.detail: Her ultimate (140/115/90s CD) anchors you in place for the duration. Play safer around wave state once she hits level 6 until your W is back up.

playing.title: Use global R instead of forcing lane
playing.detail: This matchup is even, not losing — Stand United lets you pressure other lanes rather than force a risky top-side all-in.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and all win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the trade-timing and cooldown-tracking advice is my own read on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit by Camille’s (W)! Shen can gain the upper hand in combat if he can use [W] to block Camille’s reinforced (Q)!
